beats.text: A big goal can't be done in one step.
beats.say: A big goal can't be done in one step. So agents plan: they break the goal into smaller tasks, and work through them.
Planning means splitting the goal into steps, putting them in order, and noting which steps depend on which.

beats.text: Plan first, or plan, act, replan.
beats.say: One style is plan first, then execute: predictable, and easy to inspect. Another is to plan a little, act, and replan as new information arrives.

beats.text: A step fails: revise the plan.
beats.say: When a step fails, or the world changes, the agent revises its plan, instead of blindly following the old one.

beats.text: Plans can be rigid, long, or wrong.
beats.say: Plans can be too rigid, too long, or simply wrong. Keep them short, check progress after each step, and have a human approve risky plans.

beats.text: Next up: multi-agent systems. Follow for more!
beats.say: Next up, multi-agent systems. Follow for more agentic AI.
